# 50agents

> Apps, AI agents, and automations built around how your business works. 2,300+ app integrations via viaSocket.

## Agent interfaces

- MCP (Streamable HTTP): https://50agents.com/mcp
- Public agent template catalog: GET https://50agents.com/api/plugins
- Mushrooms (full app integrations): https://mushroom.viasocket.com/
